_about: Score errata and by-ear choices, confirmed against the recording (score seconds). 'move_notes' moves a lead note the score writes at the wrong moment ('to' = where the recording plays it; the lead's previous note ends there, cut short or ringing on up to it). 'layer_notes' adds a part's note as a second hold over the held lead note it lands on. 'lead_part' makes the lead follow one part in [start, end) (score seconds). 'audio_moves' places a lead note (matched by score_start + midi) at an audio time.

move_notes.why: 2:37: the score writes the clarinets' 82 a quarter-beat after the half-bar; the recording changes notes ON the half-bar, with the trumpets (user, by ear, Nov 12: the held 82 was half a beat late; the 82's pitch energy rises ~2:37.3).
4:36: the horns move UP 69 -> 70 about half a beat before the written 70 lands; the rip's top note rings until then, a half note (user, by ear).

layer_notes.why: 2:39: the trumpets' high 85 comes in ON TOP of the band's held chord; the held note keeps going and the 85 is a second hold (user, by ear).

lead_part.why: 5:10-5:13: the horns' walk-down 65 63 62 60 -> 65 (horns 1-4 + bassoons) is what you hear over the band; the rules pick the clarinets/trumpets' 77 77 75 74 line, which isn't audible (user, by ear, Nov 13). The woodwind figure before it (5:06-5:10) stays.

audio_moves.why: 4:52: the band's chord swells in after the molto rit. (no sharp attack; the mix dips ~4:52.5 and swells from 4:52.6); the alignment lands it 0.4s early (user, by ear, Nov 13; 4:52.60 was the approved hand-timed beat).
